recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Pharmacy changes the CodeableReference target, the single-choice cardinality, or the code-versus-reference guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-6309 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request asking that MedicationStatement, and by resolution MedicationPrescription, MedicationAdministration, and MedicationDispense, support a medication code or a full Medication resource reference instead of forcing a separate Medication resource.
initial_application: No current source commit was found with an explicit FHIR-6309 reference. Jira comments state the change had already been made by August 2015, and later source history maintained the same model: FHIR-10389 added code-versus-reference guidance on the affected elements, and FHIR-25929 converted Pharmacy CodeableConcept-plus-Reference choices to CodeableReference.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources and documents MedicationPrescription as having become MedicationRequest. The current StructureDefinition files use CodeableReference with targetProfile Medication for each affected medication element. FHIR-14851 later rejected allowing both branches simultaneously, supporting the current single-choice shape. The older same-family FHIR-5633 tracker is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already implements the approved code-or-Medication-reference semantics and no necessary source edit remains.
